commission.source_quote: . The Platform shall retain a commission of twenty-five percent (25%) of the Net Order Value.

delivery_fee.source_quote: . A delivery fee of Rs. 45.00 per confirmed delivery is payable to the assigned delivery partner.

hold.source_quote: . No part of the Seller's share shall become payable unless and until delivery is confirmed by the assigned delivery partner. Settlement shall occur no earlier than seventy-two (72) hours after such confirmation.

promotion_funding.source_quote: . Discounts shall be funded 100% by the Platform.

provenance.notes: SYNTHETIC contract corpus — not a real merchant agreement.

refund.source_quote: . Where a customer refund is issued, the Seller payout shall first be reversed. Commission is refundable.

tax.source_quote: . The Platform shall withhold tax at source at one percent (1%) of the commission amount.
